hard_failures.finding: class_contract_pointer does not resolve at the declared F0 artifact. Line 35 points at artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#class_contracts.AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, while f0_binding declares declared_f0_artifact research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml at 276009f4f63d. The canonical declared artifact has no class_contracts key at all (its top level exposes classes/variants; the AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN contract sits under classes.AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN and does not carry data_class_freeze), so the key path fails at its first segment. The pointer resolves only against the authoring-tree file artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml measured c8e979a1eb48, which is byte-divergent from the declared canonical hash and is not pinned anywhere in the schema. Under the project's canonical-path policy the authoring tree must be published byte-identically to the canonical path before verdicts bind, so the single-class binding to F0 is currently verifiable only against an unpinned mirror. The taxonomy_consistency check compares contract text semantically and therefore does not close this item.
hard_failures.remedy: owner lead-formulation: either publish the authoring taxonomy byte-identically into research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml (then re-point the schema to the canonical path) or add the contract block to the canonical file and re-point class_contract_pointer at the canonical key that actually exists; re-run check_taxonomy_consistency.py and record the new F0 hash in f0_binding.

hard_failures.finding: The D0 regularity index is a two-branch disjunction whose Sobolev branch is claimed to be a registered variant but is not registered, and the two branches do not share an ambient topology. quantifiers.domains.D0 (line 59) and regularity.data_regularity (line 149) define 'Sobolev variant s > 5/2 and delta in (1/2,1), or the smooth-with-decay default'; quantifiers.formal and conclusion.statement_formal both quantify 'forall (s,delta) in D0', so one class_id denotes a statement in a weighted-Sobolev/Banach setting and a statement in a Frechet setting (genericity.ambient_space line 164 vs topology_or_measure line 165), with genericity.is_part_of_class=true. The authoring F0 contract calls this 'a registered Sobolev variant', but VARIANT_REGISTRY.json registers for parent AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN only [CH, DISTRIBUTIONAL, H2LOC, L2CONN, LIP] with no Sobolev-tagged entry, and the schema's own class_identity_variants registers only the horizon-localized CH reading. tier_1 falsifier semantics split with the domain: one (s,delta) with a non-meager extendible set refutes the whole class while leaving the other disjunct untouched. The reviewer does not assert that the disjunction is mathematically illegitimate; the hard failure is that the registration claimed for the Sobolev branch does not exist and the per-branch topology is not fixed, so the class identity is not yet decidable from the artifact.
